name: Task Validator — closed-loop deliverable check
description: Post-spawn validator for chuck-v3 docket tasks: heuristic checks (deliverable existence + size + syntactic check + freshness vs startedAt) per commandKind, plus optional LLM-introspection layer for build-class tasks. Catches the failure mode where the executor records 'completed' on exit=0 but the deliverable was never written. Salvages chuck-task-validator.mjs (heuristic path; LLM layer queued for follow-up).

repoRoot.label: Repo root for relative deliverable paths
repoRoot.help: Where intent text mentioning relative paths (e.g. 'extensions/foo/bar.mjs') resolves from.

skipLlmLayer.label: Skip LLM-introspection layer
skipLlmLayer.help: When true, validator runs heuristics only. v0.1 ships heuristic-only by default; LLM layer queued for v0.2.
